def agent_loop(plan, edit, test, issue, max_iters=3):
    history = []
    p = plan(issue)
    for _ in range(max_iters):
        patch = edit(issue, p)
        ok, report = test(patch)
        history.append({"plan": p, "passed": ok, "report": report[:200]})
        if ok:
            return patch, history
        p = p + " | refine from failures"
    return patch, history
